pluss::subsp::stats::ts::AcfOptions¶

Options of ts::acf.

AcfOptions selects how many lags are computed, how the autocovariances are normalised and whether the mean is removed.

Fields¶

Field

Type

Default

Meaning

max_lag

std::int64_t

20

The highest lag computed; the result has max_lag + 1 entries, lag 0 first. A value larger than the series allows is clamped.

norm

ts::AcfNorm

Biased

Biased divides each autocovariance by n (a valid autocorrelation sequence); Unbiased divides by n − k.

demean

bool

true

Subtract the sample mean before computing; turn it off only for a series that already has mean zero.

Guidance¶

The defaults are a sensible starting point; change a field only for the reason its row gives.
